description: Curated native routines, globals, patch sites, and UE4 native registrations recovered for the fixed executable. RVAs are module-relative and only valid for this target hash. Decoded direct-call evidence is maintained in native-body-analysis.json with explicit provenance; absence of an edge there does not rule out reflected or indirect dispatch.
